items.claim: Marcio Barbosa is one of the hardest hitters in the division with incredible first-round finishing power.
items.quote: this guy is one of the hardest hitters in the division. This guy has absolute dynamite in his hands.

items.claim: Marcio Barbosa has 18 wins with 17 coming in the very first round.
items.quote: He has 18 wins. I think 17 of those wins come in the very first round.

items.claim: Marcio Barbosa's losses come when he gets extended into later rounds.
items.quote: his losses do come when he gets extended.

items.claim: Ryan Couture's path to victory is to extend the fight, which increases his chances.
items.quote: if you're Ryan Coose, the path is going to be to extend this fight. And if he does extend this fight, his chances of winning do increase

items.claim: Ryan Couture is going to shoot for a takedown within the first 20 seconds.
items.quote: He's going to probably shoot a takedown within the first 20 seconds.

items.claim: There is an astronomical striking advantage for Marcio Barbosa over Ryan Couture at distance.
items.quote: when this fight is on the feet at distant striking, there is an astronomical advantage for Marcio Barbosa.
